race.comment: STAY HUMBLE (7) on top in the iconic Dunkeld Cup. He brings the most reliable recent profile, with a BM62 win over Sarapo followed by a third at Geelong in BM70 grade when beaten half a length as favourite. He drops right down in the weights here and will be hard to run down. OVERPRICED (10) is the in-form improver, coming off BM66 and BM62 wins at Sale and Warrnambool, both by half a length, with Sheridan Clarke staying aboard and an improving profile. DUBAI WATCH (8) has to rebound from a Cup Day failure, but the wide run gives some excuse and his previous BM70 win at Geelong, where he did beat STAY HUMBLE, keeps him in the winning mix. NAVY KING (6) was better up to a mile last time and can improve again, not discounting.
